model_structure.project_extension: starts from the WPP population on 1 January 2100 and runs to 2150

post_2100_fertility: final WPP age-specific fertility schedule held constant
post_2100_mortality: final WPP age-specific survival schedule held constant

migration.source: UW bayesMig annual net-migration-rate trajectories aligned to WPP 2024 (Azose and Raftery 2015)
migration.continuation: pooled country-level AR(1) fitted to UW bayesMig trajectories from 2070 through 2100; model-output emulator
migration.equation: r[t] = mu + phi * (r[t-1] - mu) + Normal(0, sigma)
migration.global_balance: each draw-year is shifted by a common rate across active countries, equivalent to redistributing the count discrepancy by current population; world net migration is zero
migration.age_sex_composition: borrowed from the absolute UN medium-path migration residual; impossible emigration cells are redistributed across populated cells
migration.missing_location: Holy See: retained in the population with zero migration
migration.claim_boundary: the public archive omits the fitted MCMC state; this is an AR(1) emulator of its late-horizon trajectories, not an official UN continuation
